exercises.q: It is the lack of documentation ____ slows down onboarding.
exercises.why: Use 'that' (or 'which') for things in an it-cleft sentence, not 'what'.

exercises.q: ____ I really appreciate about this team is their honesty.
exercises.why: Pseudo-cleft sentences start with 'What' (= the thing that).

exercises.q: It was in Berlin ____ they first met at a security conference.
exercises.why: After 'It was + place/time', standard it-clefts use 'that' rather than 'where'.

exercises.q: All I want ____ a clear timeline before we start.
exercises.why: 'All I want' is treated as a singular unit followed by 'is'.

exercises.q: Choose the natural cleft sentence:
opts: What I need it is more time.
What I need is more time.
That I need is more time.
It is more time what I need.
exercises.why: Do not repeat 'it' after a 'What...' clause, and do not use 'what' after 'It is...'.

exercises.q: ____ matters most is that the service stays reliable.
exercises.why: Use 'What' to mean 'the thing that' at the start of the sentence.

exercises.q: It was Maria ____ spotted the bug in production.
exercises.why: Use 'who' or 'that' when emphasizing a person.

exercises.q: The reason why we delayed the release ____ (be) a missing security patch.
exercises.why: Delayed is in the past, so 'was' matches the timeframe.

exercises.q: It wasn't until Friday ____ we received the final approval.
exercises.why: The pattern 'It wasn't until [time] that...' emphasizes when something finally happened.

exercises.q: O que precisamos fazer agora é testar o sistema.
exercises.ans: What we need to do now is test the system.
exercises.why: What + subject + need to do + is + base verb.

exercises.q: Foi só ontem que eu percebi o erro.
exercises.ans: It was only yesterday that I noticed the mistake.
exercises.why: It was only + time + that + clause.

exercises.q: Tudo o que ela pediu foi um pouco de paciência.
exercises.ans: All she asked for was a little patience.
exercises.why: All + subject + verb + was + noun phrase.

exercises.q: The auditor recommended that the company ____ its access logs immediately.
exercises.why: After 'recommend that', formal English uses the bare infinitive (review).

exercises.q: It is imperative that he ____ notified as soon as the flight lands.
exercises.why: Use 'be' after 'It is imperative that...' regardless of the subject.

exercises.q: They demanded that the manager ____ an explanation.
exercises.why: 'Demand that' takes the base subjunctive verb without -s.

exercises.q: It is crucial that the report ____ published without confidential data.
exercises.why: Passive subjunctive uses 'be + past participle' after expressions like 'It is crucial that...'.

exercises.q: Choose the correct formal subjunctive sentence:
opts: I suggest that she stays at home today.
I suggest that she to stay at home today.
I suggest that she stay at home today.
I suggest that she staying at home today.
exercises.why: After 'suggest that', use the base verb 'stay' without -s or 'to'.

exercises.q: The policy requires that every user ____ (change) their password every 90 days.
exercises.why: After 'require that', use the base verb 'change' (not changes).

exercises.q: It is important that the contract ____ (be) signed before Friday.
exercises.why: Passive subjunctive uses 'be' + past participle.

exercises.q: She requested that her name ____ (not / appear) on the public list.
exercises.why: Negative subjunctive places 'not' directly before the base verb (no 'do/does').

exercises.q: We urge that the committee ____ (consider) all the security risks.
exercises.why: After 'urge that', use the base verb 'consider'.

exercises.q: É essencial que ele chegue na hora.
exercises.ans: It is essential that he arrive on time.
exercises.why: It is essential that + he + arrive (base verb, no -s).

exercises.q: O médico recomendou que ela descanse por uma semana.
exercises.ans: The doctor recommended that she rest for a week.
exercises.why: Recommended that + she + rest (base verb).

exercises.q: Eles insistiram que o relatório fosse enviado hoje.
exercises.ans: They insisted that the report be sent today.
exercises.why: Insisted that + subject + be + past participle.
